policy: Only the nine exact reviewed rule/path/full-region/raw-message tuples may be annotated. Every other result remains uploaded. Raw SARIF is preserved; annotated evidence includes accepted external false-positive justifications. Source, caller inventory, dependency, duplicate, or manifest guard failures retain unfiltered raw output and fail the job.
